source_url: https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter (public Overpass instance; alternates: https://lz4.overpass-api.de, https://overpass.kumi.systems)
query_approach: Overpass QL bbox query for highway=* ways within Mumbai+5km buffer bbox (72.75,18.85,72.98,19.30), see scripts/download_roads.sh for exact query
license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 - OpenStreetMap Foundation. Attribution required: © OpenStreetMap contributors
download_date: NOT DOWNLOADED (Overpass requires a live parameterized query this chat session's fetch tool cannot construct/execute against a fresh URL; see scripts/download_roads.sh)
format: GeoJSON (via Overpass + osmtogeojson) or GeoParquet (via osmium/ogr2ogr conversion)
temporal_resolution: live snapshot at time of query
file_size: unknown until downloaded; likely tens of MB for Mumbai's dense road network
quality: high (OSM Mumbai coverage is generally good for major/secondary roads; local street coverage varies by neighborhood)
limitations: OSM completeness varies by area (slums/informal settlements often under-mapped). One-way, bridge, tunnel, speed tags are present only where OSM contributors added them - do not assume 100% attribute completeness.
processing: none - keep as retrieved from Overpass, converted to GeoJSON
notes: Requested attributes (geometry, OSM ID, name, highway class, oneway, bridge, tunnel, maxspeed) map directly to OSM tags: name, highway, oneway, bridge, tunnel, maxspeed.
